name: Samagra Portal Support Helpline
department: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
beneficiary: All residents of MP needing Samagra ID creation, modification, or scheme mapping
benefits: Direct support for updating Samagra family ID, e-KYC status, and linked welfare benefits.
eligibility: Any resident or family registered on the Samagra Portal
application_process: Call 0755-2700800 or contact your local ward/gram panchayat office for ID issues.
